text.description_html:
Replacement LCN 4040 ADA Compliant Global Heavy Duty Door Closer

Global Door Controls heaviest duty overhead door closer. It is recommend for use on heavy duty commercial, architectural and institutional applications. Closers with non-hold open arms are UL listed R7483 615R for "A" label fire doors.

The unique hole pattern offers a variety of options and features for both new construction and retrofit/tennant improvement installs. Supplied with a full cover, standard duty arm and a parallel arm bracket to accomodate all applications. Comes with all fasteners and brackets in 2 finish choices. A complete line of Global TC4300 Door Closer Accessories is available.

Global Series TC4300 Door Closers are non-handed and have individual adjustments for sweep speed, latch speed, and backcheck cushioning. They are tri packed for regular, top jamb or parallel arm installations and direct fit replacement for a LCN 4041 (LCN 4040 series).

Features and Specifications of Global TC4300 Heavy Duty Door Closer

  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Adjustable back check
  • Aluminum Alloy Shell
  • Maximum Door Size: 60" interior / 48" exterior
  • Maximum Door Weight: 258 lbs
  • Spring Tension: Adjustable 1-6
  • Tri packed for regular, top jamb or parallel arm mounting
  • Non Handed
  • Optional Arms: Heavy Duty Arm, Cushion Arm or Hold Open Arm
  • ANSI/BHMA A156.4 ADA Compliant
  • UL 10C Compliant
  • Includes Slim Line Cover
  • Grade 1 Certified
  • 25 Year Manufacture Warranty

The TC4300 is ADA Compliant offering adjustable spring power sizes 1 - 6 for use on interior doors requiring less than 5 lbs. of opening force and exterior doors requiring less than 8.5 lbs.

NOTE: the standard arm shown in the upper right product image is included.
